flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Payment/PaymentCash.tsx (Update Manual Payment page, search by Notice No.), utils/data/LinkData.tsx and App.tsx (menu + route), pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchOutstandingForm,list/NoticeSearchOutstandingList,hook/useSearchParams} (separate Search Outstanding Notices page: ID No., Vehicle No., Offender Name). ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (OCMS_PAYMENT_CASH). No code in ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, ocmseserviceapi or ocmseserviceui for this search.
note: Status 'Fully paid' in the sheet; the requirement is not 'No requirement'. The story asks the officer to search notices by vehicle number, ID number or notice number. The manual payment page (Update Manual Payment) only accepts Notice No. (PaymentCash.tsx:192-202). Search by Vehicle No. and ID No. exists on a different page, Search Outstanding Notices (/notices/search/outstanding), which has no menu entry and no link to the payment page that I could find (LinkData.tsx:30-38 lists only the ALL search). So those two indicators are Sebagian, not Sesuai. Server-side authorization is via api-authorization.properties:111-112; per-user role assignment cannot be verified from the repo. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Claim partially: search by Notice No. on the payment page works. Vehicle No. and ID No. exist only on the separate Search Outstanding Notices page without a menu entry; ask URA whether that page is what they meant, or add the fields to the payment page.

steps.step: Officer opens the notice search page in the staff portal to record a non e-payment payment
steps.detail: Menu Payment > 'Update Manual Payment' (path /payment/cash) leads to the PaymentCash component, which has a search box (LinkData.tsx:267-275; App.tsx:334-340; PaymentCash.tsx:433-439). The endpoints it calls are listed under OCMS_PAYMENT_CASH in api-authorization.properties:111-112. Which roles hold OCMS_PAYMENT_CASH cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Officer searches for notices by notice number
steps.detail: The 'Notice No.' box is required, 10 characters (PaymentCash.tsx:192-202), and the format is validated via Format('NOTICE') (ValidCash.ts:8-24). The Search button calls POST validoffencenoticelist with noticeNo and $limit 1 (PaymentCash.tsx:50-63, 157-174).

steps.step: Officer searches for notices by vehicle number
steps.detail: The payment page has no searchable Vehicle No. field; Vehicle No. there is read-only and filled after a notice is found (PaymentCash.tsx:304-310). Search by vehicle_no exists on the Search Outstanding Notices page (NoticeSearchOutstandingForm.tsx:66-68; useSearchParams.tsx:325), route /notices/search/:search_type (App.tsx:97-106), but the menu lists only the ALL search (LinkData.tsx:30-38) and nothing links from that page to /payment/cash (grep 'payment' in pages/NoticeSearch: 0 hits). A generic mechanism exists but it is not the payment flow, so Sebagian.

steps.step: Officer searches for notices by ID number
steps.detail: Same as Vehicle No.: the payment page only accepts Notice No. (PaymentCash.tsx:192-202). An 'ID No.' field exists on Search Outstanding Notices (NoticeSearchOutstandingForm.tsx:40-55) and is sent as idNo (useSearchParams.tsx:530), but that page is separate from the payment flow and not in the menu (LinkData.tsx:30-38).
